name: Vivek Kumar
title: Graphic & UI/UX Designer
profile: Graphic & UI/UX Designer with about a year of hands-on experience across brand identity, websites and product interfaces. At AlgoRoot I rebuilt brand identities, redesigned the company website and revamped AI product UIs, taking work from wireframes to developer-ready Figma files. I combine a strong base in typography, layout and visual hierarchy with user research, design systems and motion design from my Dice Academy certification.

bullets: Rebuilt brand identity: redesigned the AlgoRoot logo and created a new visual identity for AlgoJob.
Redesigned the AlgoRoot website end to end, bringing clearer visual hierarchy, typography and consistency across pages.
Revamped the UI/UX of AlgoJob's AI career platform with simpler navigation and information architecture, and redesigned the AlgoVox product interface.
Produced wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity Figma files with developer handoff documentation.
Worked with dev and marketing teams in an agile setup and applied WCAG accessibility standards.

projects.name: VOLT 47
bullets: Built a 24-hour city gym identity around one logo shape read three ways: a wedge cut at 23°, three barbell plates and a bolt in negative space; flat vector that holds from a 16 px app icon to a lit shopfront sign.
Delivered logo suite, colour and type system (Anton + Space Grotesk), pattern, eight applications, a three-post social kit and an eight-second logo reveal with sound.

projects.name: Watien Boutique
bullets: Identity for a luxury bag and jewellery boutique (name means "soul" in Arabic): logo, custom typography, deep green and gold palette, packaging, merchandise mockups, signage and brand presentation.

projects.name: ShopUp
bullets: Ran user research and usability testing with 6 participants, then redesigned product discovery and checkout and added real-time delivery tracking.

projects.name: Talksy
bullets: Designed a messaging app in Figma covering onboarding, chat and settings, backed by a reusable design system.

projects.name: Bewakoof
bullets: Audited the app against Nielsen's 10 heuristics, severity-rated the gaps and wrote prioritised recommendations.

projects.name: Social Media & Poster Design
bullets: Social posts for gaming, F&B, beauty/skincare and lifestyle brands; cinematic, sport, product advertising and editorial typographic posters.
